caption:
UWS Briefly · Aug 20–26

• Youman Wilder, the coach who stood between ICE agents and his players in Riverside Park, died at 63.
• Barzini's, on Broadway near 90th since 1983, closes at the end of August, an employee says.
• The Health Department shut the Sweetgreen at 311 Amsterdam. Roaches. At the salad place.
• New Asia, the Chinese takeout spot, got shut down too: 60 violation points, starting with live roaches.
• 323 W. 96th St., all 15 stories, sold for $88 million.
• Doughnut Plant is coming to 2169 Broadway, near 76th, before the end of the year.
• The sidewalk shed on Broadway between 90th and 91st came down and the old Big Daddy's sign was still under it. The relief looks temporary.
• Gottesman Pool in Central Park is closed until next week. In August.

Links to every story are in our bio.
Reporting by I Love the Upper West Side, West Side Rag.
